title: Ines and the Locker
author: Sable Zhou
blurb: Wren Nystrom, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
